name: Hrady a zámky na Slovensku — Castles and châteaux of Slovakia
title: Hrady a zámky na Slovensku — Castles and châteaux of Slovakia
description: Castles, castle ruins, and châteaux (zámky) located in Slovakia, sourced from Wikidata via SPARQL. Includes any item whose P31 (instance of) traces through P279* (subclass) to either Q23413 (castle) or Q751876 (château), filtered by P17 (country) = Q214 (Slovakia). The Slovak distinction between hrad (fortified medieval castle) and zámok (representative château/manor) is preserved in the per-record `types` field. Coverage: 199/215 (92.6%) name_sk, 138/215 (64.2%) name_en, 193/215 (89.8%) coordinates, 148/215 (68.8%) Wikimedia Commons image, 98/215 (45.6%) inception date, 207/215 (96.3%) administrative location (P131), 135/215 (62.8%) heritage designation, 133/215 (61.9%) Slovak Wikipedia link, 66/215 (30.7%) English Wikipedia link. Type breakdown: 109 castles, 100 castle ruins, 25 châteaux, 9 palaces, 6 manor houses, 4 towers, 3 hunting lodges. Inception breakdown: 13th century dominates (55), followed by 14th century (14) and 12th century (7). Notable records include Spišský hrad (Spiš Castle, UNESCO World Heritage), Bratislavský hrad (Bratislava Castle), Devín, Trenčiansky hrad (Trenčín), Oravský hrad (Orava), Bojnický zámok (Bojnice Castle).
